sources.name: Hand-authored seed dataset: countries
sources.coverage: Hand-picked representative country points, used where no country list covers an ISO3 code the data references.

sources.name: Hand-authored seed dataset: facilities
sources.coverage: Hand-authored facilities: real mines, smelters and refineries with approximate coordinates, standing in until a facility source is dropped in.

sources.name: Hand-authored seed dataset: flows
sources.coverage: Hand-authored country-to-country flows on a contained-metal basis, standing in until a bilateral trade extract is dropped in.

sources.name: Hand-authored seed dataset: prices
sources.coverage: Indicative annual average prices, order-of-magnitude only, used where no price source covers a mineral.
